Package zephyr.daemon.model

Class ZephyrPricingRecord

java.lang.Object
zephyr.daemon.model.ZephyrPricingRecord
public class ZephyrPricingRecord extends Object
The oracle prices a Zephyr block was built with, as the daemon serializes them in the block header's pricing_record. The values are in the daemon's fixed-point units (10^12 per unit, like amounts). Per field: spot and moving average are the price of ZPH in USD; stable and reserve are the rates of the stable asset ZSD and the reserve asset ZRS (each with its moving average); reserve ratio and its moving average are the reserve ratio; yield price is the price of the yield asset; the timestamp is the oracle's timestamp; the signature is the oracle's signature. ZephyrReserveInfo is the wallet-side view; this is the per-block record.
